cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first dinner since the breakup, and you groaned at my waiter joke. That's recognition. Please don't dismiss it as a bad start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was hoping you'd stopped telling it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need to distinguish disappointment from indifference. You're still hoping for improvement. Good. We can work with that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we just eat in silence? I'm tired of having my reactions analysed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence it is. Thank you for specifying what you need; that's clearer communication than we managed together.

reason: Remove the redundant promise to stop talking; retain the expert grading that turns B's refusal into evidence of connection.
